title: An Interactive Evolutionary Multiobjective Optimization Algorithm Based on Interpretable Active Preference Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.35470v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Many decision-making tasks are inherently multi-objective. Interactive evolutionary multi-objective optimization algorithms (iEMOAs) are particularly well-suited to help the decision-maker find their most preferred solution. However, many of these algorithms employ black-box preference models. For high-stakes decision-making tasks, like healthcare and defense, a high level of transparency is needed, for instance to support accountability. We propose an interpretable iEMOA which uses active learning to efficiently learn a tree-based preference model directly from pairwise comparisons. The survival operator of NSGA-II and NSGA-III is extended with the learned preference model to guide the algorithm towards the region of interest. An extensive experimental study compares the proposed method to a state-of-the-art black-box model and a state-of-the-art interpretable model. Results indicate that our proposed model outperforms the alternative

translated_title: 基于可解释主动偏好学习的交互式多目标进化优化算法
translated_abstract: 许多决策任务本质上是多目标的。交互式进化多目标优化算法特别适合帮助决策者找到其最偏好的解。然而，许多此类算法采用黑盒偏好模型。对于医疗和国防等高风险决策任务，需要高度的透明度，例如以支持问责制。我们提出了一种可解释的交互式进化多目标优化算法，它利用主动学习直接从成对比较中高效地学习基于树的偏好模型。通过学习到的偏好模型扩展NSGA-II和NSGA-III的生存算子，以引导算法趋向感兴趣区域。一项广泛的实验研究将所提出的方法与最先进的黑盒模型和最先进的可解释模型进行了比较。结果表明，我们提出的模型优于其他替代模型。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于可解释主动偏好学习的交互式多目标进化优化算法，通过主动学习从成对比较中直接学习树状偏好模型并扩展NSGA-II/NSGA-III的生存算子，在保持透明度和可解释性的同时，性能优于最先进的黑盒模型和可解释模型。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an interpretable interactive evolutionary multi-objective optimization algorithm that uses active learning to efficiently learn a tree-based preference model directly from pairwise comparisons, extending the survival operators of NSGA-II and NSGA-III to guide the search, and outperforming both state-of-the-art black-box and interpretable models while maintaining transparency for high-stakes decision-making.
